sources.title: GitHub - thewh1teagle/pocket-tts-onnx: PocketTTS with onnxruntime and ...
sources.snippet: Kyutai's Pocket TTS exported to one self-contained .onnx — graph, tokenizer, voices, encoder and adapter all in the same file — decoding frame by frame on onnxruntime alone. Then grab a model from the releases and drop it in the working directory. Or skip all of it and run it in your browser ...
